population: pregnant women with autoimmune disease (6 patients)
notes: Rowspan regression case. The source table has a 3-row header (rowspan=3 leaf columns beside a colspan=3 group) and pairs of physical rows per patient: the first carries every measurement with rowspan=2, the second supplies ONLY the second line of the non-spanning 'Dosing regimen' column. That interleaving broke the converter two ways -- carried cells were emitted only as a contiguous prefix, so everything after the first non-carried column was dropped from the continuation row; and the ragged-row padding read rowspan_tracker AFTER the whole table was parsed, filling those gaps with leftovers from unrelated rows. The result gave patients 1 and 2 patient 3's concentrations, and folded data values into two column NAMES ('Cord-to-maternal ratio.1.71.1.71'). Both curation runs over this paper (qwen3.8:27b and qwen3.6:35b) burned their whole context trying to reconcile the contradiction and produced no output at all. Only the deterministic stage-00 oracle is bundled; no LLM stages were captured for this case.

oracle_kind.stage_00_markdown: deterministic (byte-exact; enforced by test_stage0_conversion.py). Verified by hand against the source markup: each patient's continuation row must repeat that patient's own measurements, and the two ratio columns must be plain names carrying no numbers.
